task.summary: The target video opens on the supplied first frame and runs forward from it. <Subject 1> crouches in a summer meadow with a magnifying glass, speaks one delighted line in English to somebody off-frame, then goes quiet as a butterfly settles. Two shots: the opening wide from the keyframe, and a low push-in as she speaks.

geometry_stage_1.rule: adapt_canvas at the resolved target canvas, no crop for a first frame

geometry_stage_2.resolved_by: the release Qwen still processor at batch build

subjects.definition: the child shown in <Picture 1>: about eight years old, brown hair in two low pigtails, round dark-rimmed glasses, a short-sleeved rainbow tie-dye t-shirt, crouched among tall cosmos and daisies holding a magnifying glass up in her right hand. Retain her face, glasses, pigtails and the tie-dye shirt.
subjects.retention: fully_preserved - <Picture 1> is the first frame of the target video, so her appearance, the meadow and the framing at time zero are exactly the supplied image and the sequence moves forward from it

shots.camera: the supplied first frame held, a wide low-angle among the flower heads, bright midday sun
shots.action: <Subject 1> crouches among the cosmos with the magnifying glass raised, an orange monarch butterfly hovering just past the lens and bees working the blooms around her.

events.requirement: She does not speak while the opening frame holds and her lips stay closed.

shots.closing: The flower heads sway and the butterfly drifts a hand's width closer.

shots.camera: the camera pushes in slowly from the low angle to a tight single, the flowers sliding out of focus in the foreground
shots.action: <Subject 1> turns her head toward somebody off-frame to her left, eyes wide behind the glasses.

events.speaker: <Subject 1>
events.words: Come look, it has got tiny orange spots on its wings!
events.delivery: calls out brightly and quickly, half-whispering so as not to startle it
events.mouth: her lips moving clearly with the words
events.lead: Turning to somebody off-frame, <Subject 1> calls out brightly and quickly

events.requirement: After the line she presses her lips shut and holds completely still as the butterfly settles on the rim of the magnifying glass.

shots.closing: The butterfly opens and closes its wings once on the lens rim and the push-in stops.

sound.overall: A warm open-field ambience of wind through tall stems and steady bee hum in the near foreground. One bright half-whispered English line sits above it in the second half, followed by a held quiet in which only the wind and a single close wingbeat remain.
sound.non_diegetic: None. The sequence carries field sound only.

render.matched_seeds: the whole seed set is rendered for every arm

_notes: Keyframe role, so stage-one geometry is the target canvas rather than the still policy; the still policy field still applies to any reference still the scene might gain.
